author: Ben Janca
description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is all about robberies. Here's a breakdown of everything we know about them, and how they could kick the doors open for exciting emergent moments.
title: GTA 6’s Robberies NEED To Be Unpredictable

author: Steve Watts
description:
Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave is an epic intertwining story set in an Age of Antiquity that most closely resembles Ancient Greece. But! It is also a guns-blazing shiny metal futuristic sci-fi story, and judging by the social media reactions, a lot of people weren't exactly prepared for how hard it leans into that element right from the start. 

In the interest of not spoiling the game and abiding by certain embargo restrictions, we had to say mum about the first hour of Fortune's Weave when previews were published in August. By then it felt like a secret we were all sitting on, especially when a Fire Emblem-themed Nintendo Direct aired and didn't make even the slightest mention of how absolutely buckwild the first hour is. The review embargo was a little looser and I was able to mention in my Fortune's Weave review that
title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave’s First Hour Is Wild

author: Jordan Ramée
description:
I've been loving Star Wars Zero Company, especially for how it builds on my favorite story arc from The Clone Wars animated series. But whereas I was positive that Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave would be the title to finally pull me away from Zero Company, it's another tactics game that has captured my attention: Ex Sanguis.

It's no real surprise why I'm enjoying Lightbulb Crew's Ex Sanguis. While it's not a direct sequel to the studio's debut title, Othercide (one of my favorite games of 2020), E
title: Here’s The Great New Tactics Game You Should Be Playing–And I Don’t Mean Fire Emblem Or Zero Company

author: Callum Self
description:
The history of James Bond games is a little wonky. GoldenEye 007 remains a landmark in gaming history, marking one of the best FPS games of all time almost 30 years ago. Everything or Nothing was a solid classic, but for every good game featuring the MI6 agent, there are some bad ones. Now, I’m not naming names, but I’m specifically looking at 007 Legends and 007 Racing—which, despite the name, isn’t a racing game. Fortunately, IO Interactive’s 007 First Light is firmly on the good side, standing alongside the N64’s GoldenEye as one of the more memorable Bond games, and with a huge update, it’s now cheaper than ever, too.

I know you might want to say (Dr.) No to this deal, but let me sell you on why 007 First Light is one of this year’s best games. Firstly, it’s a pseudo-prequel, which
title: 007 First Light Just Got Its Biggest Update Yet, And You Can Get It At Its Lowest Price Ever Right Now

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Tucked away at the bottom of Rockstar's blog post today announcing GTA 6: The Album was a line about other updates to come for the game regarding its sound and music.

Rockstar said fans should "stay tuned for more details about the music of GTA 6," and specifically the game's "dynamic score." Additionally, Rockstar teased that GTA 6 will feature the "next evolution of in-game radio, and more."
title: GTA 6 Will Feature The “Next Evolution Of In-Game Radio,” Rockstar Says

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 has been in development since 2015, and a lot of things have happened since then, including the recent discovery a new species of cat.

The scientific journal Current Biology disclosed the discovery of Leopardus tilcayo--known as the tilca
title: Scientists Discovered A New Cat Before Rockstar Could Finish GTA 6

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
The upcoming 99 Nights in the Forest movie, based on the super-popular Roblox survival-horror game, has reportedly brought on a very big name.

According to The Hollywood Reporter, 20th Century Studios--which is owned by Disney--has hired Josh Cooley to write the script. Cooley directed the Oscar-winning Pixar movie Toy Story 4. He also earned an Academy Award nomination for Inside Out. Beyond Disney movies, Cooley directed Transformers One.
title: Roblox Movie 99 Nights In The Forest Brings On Oscar-Winning Toy Story 4 Director

author: Steve Watts
description:
Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave is a masterpiece of a Fire Emblem game, but one beloved element that fans of the series have grown attached to is missing in action this time around--or at least, very downplayed.

Romance has been a staple of the Fire Emblem series for years, especially since Fire Emblem Awakening lets you couple up characters and then access the next generation of their children. Three Houses and Engage continued this tradition to a more limited degree, letting your player-character choose a special someone to share a bond with, and watching other characters pair with their highest support levels. By comparison, Fortune's Weave takes a step back from this.
title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave Tones Down The Romance

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Popcorn buckets for movies are all the rage today. Basically every big movie has one. But they aren't all created equally. One popcorn bucket that looks like it could be the best one yet is for this October's Street Fighter movie.

Revealed today by Cody Rhodes, the Street Fighter popcorn bucket, which will be exclusive to AMC locations, is modeled after his character Guile's epic hair. The popcorn goes in the bucket, and then you can put it on your head and grab the popcorn from up there. Or you can plop it in your lap and eat the popcorn normally. In a word, the popcorn bucket is perfect. If you need three words, Rhodes said the popcorn bucket is "aerodynamic, ergonomic, delicious."

Check out the glorious announcement video for the Street Fighter popcorn bucket below.
title: Street Fighter Movie’s Popcorn Bucket Is Absolutely Perfect. No Notes.

author: Gabe Gurwin
description:
2027 is shaping up to be another big year for new video games, as the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S continue to get plenty of games despite their massively increased prices, and Nintendo's Switch 2 has been, slowly but surely, getting a great lineup of exclusives. Whether you're waiting for a new soulslike or the big new AAA first-person shooter, 2027 very likely has something you can look forward to playing. 

To break it all down as we move into 2027, GameSpot has outlined all the upcoming games for the year by month. Those games given a broader "2027" window are all included at the bottom of this page, as well, and as games continue to get final dates (or are announced for a 2027 window), they'll continue to be added to the list. For more, you can read up on all the games released in 2026 to see any you missed.
title: 2027 Upcoming Games Release Schedule

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Ahead of its release next month, the official PC specs for Gears of War: E-Day have been revealed. The next game in the series has looked good in recent previews, and if you're aiming to reach a high level of fidelity, you're going to need some fairly chunky PC hardware for 4K gibs and perfect reloads. The good news is that no matter which graphics preset you choose, you'll only need 16GB of RAM--welcome news considering just how much memory costs in the current tech climate.

One thing worth pointing out is that graphics cards without dedicated ray-tracing hardware aren't supported. It's not the first time this has been the case--Indiana Jones and the Great Circle being a prime example--but it does create a hard generational lock for interested players. By making ray-tracing hardware a baseline requirement,
title: Gears Of War: E-Day On PC Won’t Let You Play Without A Ray Tracing-Capable GPU

author: Steve Watts
description:
Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave is a sprawling tale composed of four different interconnected heroes, each with their own story campaign. These can be played in any order, and the choice might seem daunting. Which hero is the best to start your journey with? The simple answer is that you can begin with any hero you choose, but if you want to make an informed choice about which one might work best for your tastes, we can help.

After a brief prologue, you're taken to the Obelisk Chamber, where you'll see the obelisks to the four Flame Lords. Those are your passageways into their individual stories. What sets the Flame Lords apart are their special questlines, their Blaze Arts, and their surrounding cast. While you have a great deal of flexibility in recruiting new soldiers to your side and steering your party members in any direction, they are mostly built to excel at particular class types and that will define the type of
title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave – Which Flame Lord Should You Pick First?

author: Cameron Koch
description:
World of Warcraft: Forever, Blizzard's next evolution of WoW Classic that will see significant changes and content additions, is fully playable on controller.

I got to experience WoW: Forever's new Skyborne elf starting zone with the control scheme during a hands-on demo at BlizzCon 2026. A prompt outlining the controls noted controller support was in an "alpha" state, but despite supposedly still being in early development, it worked surprisingly well.

That's a first for Blizzard's MMORPG. Though Blizzard has added barebones support for controllers in recent years, an entirely mouse-and-keyboard-free setup relies on unofficial, player-made add-ons like ConsolePort to delive
title: I Played WoW: Forever On A Controller, And That’s Big News

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar has described GTA 6 as a "single-player experience," but everyone expects the game to eventually include a multiplayer element given the enormous success of the existing GTA Online. But when could GTA 6's online multiplayer release? According to Twitch CEO Dan Clancy, fans can expect it sometime in 2027.

He said this in an interview with Bloomberg (
title: GTA 6 Multiplayer Could Launch In 2027, Twitch CEO Says

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 launches in November for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, but is it also going to release on PC? It won't at launch, but history suggests it will come to PC further down the track. Now, Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick has commented on the company's approach to PC releases generally.

At the company's virtual shareholder meeting today, as reported by
title: GTA 6 Boss Says PC Is Becoming “More And More Important”

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
October is going to be a tough month for anyone on a budget, as a ton of big games are coming up. Sandwiched between an already-packed September and the November release of GTA 6, how does any game stand out from the pack? In the case of Valor Mortis, a launch price of $40--and day-one availability via Xbox Game Pass--might be a winning combination to help it shift units.

"We've had many discussions over the past year about the price of Valor Mortis," developer One More Level and publisher Lyrical Games wrote in a statement. "We believe the game has the quality, fidelity,
title: Game’s Price Is Lower Because This Fall Is So Packed, Dev Admits

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is one of the most-anticipated game releases ever, and despite the enormous hype, Rockstar and owner Take-Two are going to market the game aggressively. Why does the game even need a marketing push? According to Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick, just because a franchise is popular and well known, that doesn't mean the company behind it can take their foot off the pedal in terms of spending time and money on marketing.

Zelnick said 2023's The Barbie Movie is a good example of this.

“All of us saw the Barbie movie, and they marketed the living daylights out of that picture. Even though the IP is very well known. Secondly, it was out there for a while. We all got
title: GTA Is Like Barbie, Take-Two Boss Says

description: We got to check out Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance and see what was new, such as the Boost Driver, Skybound Eyrie location, and two monsters Araketa and Teostra.
title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance Gameplay

description: Japan: A place beautifully suspended between two worlds. Here, historic neighborhoods and tradition sit alongside the bustling energy of the modern city. Get ready to fall in love with the land of the rising sun when Crazy Taxi: World Tour hits the streets in 2027!
title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour – Welcome to Japan Gameplay Trailer

author: Ben Janca
description:
The human experience is counterfeit.
Only pain and pleasure reveal the nature of their world.
You must bargain with the Scarlet Church, for they can smell the Labyrinth on you…

In the brand-new Steam demo for Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival, players can dive into the mysterious hellscape of the Labyrinth and face off against the wicked Scarlet Church, which has taken the coveted Genesis Configuration into its possession. You'll be introduced to the main characters of the story and their twisted machinations while traversing an ever-shifting realm of nightmares. Discover the basics of combat, crafting and puzzling solving while preparing your body for the complete experience at launch!

Among the many wicked dangers in this brand-new story in the iconic horror franchise, including Pinhead himself (voiced by the legendary Doug Bradley), you'll have to overcome Marlowe and his
title: Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival – Scarlet Church Trailer

description:
After touring the wastelands of extinction-level events in Death Stranding, what's next for Hideo Kojima? The veteran game designer is keeping busy with two projects that Xbox will publish, and one of them is a return to his roots of tactics, espionage, and action: Physint. Still years away, Physint is already building buzz ahead of its eventual release, with new details slowly trickling out as development continues. First revealed during the PlayStation State of Play January 2024 showcase, here's everything that we know about it so far.

Physint release date

Physint doesn't have a release date yet, and don't expect it to be out for quite some time. Kojima himself has said as
title: Physint Release Date-Estimate, Gameplay, And Everything We Know

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Microsoft has announced the next DLC for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, and it's a plane that costs more than the game itself. The Airbus A380 is now in the game, and you can get it for $74.50. For comparison, the game itself costs $70.

It is a digital version of the "superjumbo," four-engine, wide-body airliner made by Airbus. For people who aren't up to date with this kind of the thing, the A380 is the world's biggest commercial passenger plane, with 10 airlines operating them, including Emirates, British Airways, Qantas, and Lufthansa. There are fewer than 200 in service around the world.

The developers worked with longtime partners iniBuilds to make
title: MS Flight Sim Adds New Plane That Costs More Than The Game, And It Includes “Waste” Simulation

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description: If there's one thing that Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth players can agree on, it's that the game has far too much Chadley in it. While he was a valuable source of Summons in Final Fantasy 7 Remake, in Rebirth, he's an omnipresent voice tied to almost every open-world activity thanks to the "CHAD Module" you're burdened with early in the game. Will the Chad be back in Final Fantasy 7 Revelation? Unfortunately, yes. Will he have an expanded role in the game's story this time? It sure sounds like it, as game director Naoki Hamaguchi teased that Chadley won't be sitting on the sidelines for the final chapter of the remake trilogy.
title: Chadley Is Back For Final Fantasy 7 Revelation, Whether You Like It Or Not

description:
In addition to being a creature-catching game, Aniimo also offers you a RV home and the ability to farm with your Aniimo friends. There are a series of quests you'll need to complete in order to unlock this homesteading feature, and this guide will show you exactly how to find the NPC Fannie, get your RV, and level up your home.

Aniimo's Homeland explained
title: Aniimo – How To Unlock The Wondrous RV Quest And Homeland Feature

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar Games has officially announced Grand Theft Auto 6: The Album. The 34-song collection includes original music from people like Keith Richards, Yung Lean, Morgan Wallen, Rauw Alejandro, and more. Rockstar is releasing the album in partnership with Atlantic Records.

In addition to a lot of brand-new songs, GTA 6 will feature famous licensed music as well. Check out GameSpot's rundown of all the songs rumored and confirmed for the game so far.

The soundtrack releases on November 19 alongside the game, and Rockstar is offering "multiple vinyl and CD" versions at retailers. So yes, GTA 6 will be on a disc, or at least the soundtrack will be. The game itself, though? That's a digital e
title: GTA 6 The Album Gets A Physical Release, Even Though The Game Won’t

description:
The official campaign trailer for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 was revealed during Xbox's Tokyo Game Show broadcast, and it gave a surprise reveal of star Mads Mikkelsen, who is known for roles such as Death Stranding and Hannibal. Based on his character's interactions with Captain Price, it's likely Mikkelsen is playing a major antagonist in Modern Warfare 4.

Activision's latest blog gives further campaign details, teasing a "catastrop
title: Mads Mikkelsen Appears In CoD: Modern Warfare 4 Campaign Trailer

description:
Bill Skarsgard has been cast in the lead role of Hideo Kojima's upcoming action-espionage game, Physint, Kojima Productions has announced. The project is being developed in partnership with Xbox after PlayStation stepped away from the game earlier this year.

Known for his roles in It, John Wick, and Boy Kills World, Skarsgard will take the role of the player character in the game alongside previously announced cast members including Charlee Fraser, Don Lee, and Minami Hamabe.

Kojima has previously described Physint as an action-espionage game that will blur the line between games and

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Kingdom Hearts has officially landed in Fortnite, and as expected, the update has brought plenty of cosmetics and weapons to the game. The content includes the Kingdom Key, a weapon Epic says can be used to clobber opponents and call down a shocking bolt of lightning when you need to clear the battlefield. If you're running low on health and shields, you can also grab a Sea Salt Ice Cream to top them up for the battles that lie ahead.

But once you're underneath the heart-shaped moon on the ol' Fortnite island? That's when you can start using Kingdom Hearts Overrides to your advantage. Players can activate a Recovery Override to gain healing orbs whenever they eliminate another player equipped with a weapon, while the Level Up O
title: Kingdom Hearts Has Invaded Fortnite, And There’s A Lot To Collect

description:
The Tokyo Game Show kicked off this week, and Xbox is celebrating its presence with a new broadcast dedicated to showing off what its Japanese partners are up to. The Japanese market has been a tough nut to crack for Microsoft--especially with Sony and Nintendo enjoying a home-field advantage--but Xbox has had a presence there for the last 20 years.

Hosted by Misuzu Araki, this year’s Xbox TGS broadcast will offer exclusive content and new gameplay. It's also taking place at a very early hour, and we're betting that you might be sleeping through it. Fear not! As usual, we'll be covering all the announcements during the presentation, and you can scroll below to catch up on all the news and trailers.

title: Xbox At Tokyo Game Show 2026: All The Biggest Announcements And Trailers
